verdicts.reason: Both lose every piece of text: the headline 'We help choosing the right smartphone', the URL and the 'HO SMART' wordmark are gone. A's blue panel at the top is empty, and its white-outline logo sits on white, so it is nearly invisible. Its diagonal stripes are misplaced over the photo, and the bottom 60% of the canvas is dead space. B just shrinks the original banner into a thin strip in the middle of a blank tall canvas, with a tiny, low-contrast logo floating above it. B is a squashed copy rather than a rearrangement and is mostly empty. A is marginally less bad because it at least stacks the elements vertically and shows the logo at a usable size.
